name: Mrs Stork
text: Every 6 gold you spend: the Bird away longest comes home, if it has missed a fight.
golden_text: Every 6 gold you spend: the two Birds away longest come home, if they have missed a fight.
details: Among eligible Birds, longest away first; a tie goes to the leftmost Nest.

source.note: As amended by Pass 2 design: review calls in DECISIONS.md.
